menstrual_health.description: General information about menstrual cycles, common cramps, PMS, and changes in menstrual patterns.
questions: When was your last menstrual period?
Are your cycles usually regular?
How long does your period usually last?
How heavy is the bleeding compared with your usual periods?
How severe are your cramps or pain?
Are your symptoms affecting your normal daily activities?
general_guidance: Track your menstrual cycle and symptoms.
Use comfortable self-care measures that are safe for you.
Discuss persistent or unusual changes with a qualified healthcare professional.
seek_medical_help_when: Bleeding is unusually heavy or persistent.
Period pain is severe or significantly affects daily activities.
Periods become repeatedly irregular or significantly different from your usual pattern.

pregnancy_related_concerns.description: Provides general guidance for pregnancy-related concerns without attempting to diagnose pregnancy complications.
questions: Is pregnancy possible or confirmed?
How far along is the pregnancy, if known?
What symptoms are you experiencing?
How severe are the symptoms?
Are you experiencing pain, bleeding, dizziness, fainting, or vomiting?
general_guidance: Do not rely on the assistant to diagnose pregnancy-related complications.
Contact a qualified healthcare professional when symptoms are unusual or concerning.
pregnancy_related_concerns.recommended_action: Seek urgent medical assessment when serious warning signs are present.

vaginal_symptoms.description: General guidance for unusual vaginal symptoms and when professional evaluation may be appropriate.
questions: What symptoms are you experiencing?
How long have the symptoms been present?
Is there unusual discharge?
Has the color, amount, or smell changed?
Are you experiencing itching, burning, sores, or pelvic pain?
Do you have fever?
Could there have been an exposure to an infection?
general_guidance: Avoid self-diagnosing based only on symptoms.
Keep the area clean using gentle hygiene practices.
Seek professional evaluation for persistent or unusual symptoms.
seek_medical_help_when: There is a strong or unusual odor.
Sores or unusual skin changes appear.
Symptoms occur after possible exposure to an infection.

breast_concerns.description: General information about breast changes that may need professional assessment.
questions: Have you noticed a new lump or swelling?
How long has the change been present?
Is there persistent breast pain?
Have you noticed nipple changes?
Is there unusual nipple discharge?
Have you noticed changes in the breast skin?
general_guidance: Many breast changes can have different causes and cannot be assessed reliably through an AI assistant alone.
Monitor changes but do not ignore persistent or unusual findings.
Discuss new or persistent breast changes with a qualified healthcare professional.
seek_medical_help_when: Persistent or unexplained breast pain occurs.
